title: 第1章 仙尊不可辱第2章 挣钱啊挣钱
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
昆仑山上，白雪皑皑，随处可见高大无比的雪松和时不时从一边草丛里窜出来的白色皮毛的野生动物，又或者从上空云端掠过的野鹤。
而这天在昆仑山的某一处最高最矗立的山峰上，则站着两人。
一个人是一个白发苍苍，手拿拂尘的老者，老者仙风鹤骨看起来就像是天上的老神仙一样，又或许他本身就是神仙。
另外一个则是一个一身白衣，容貌无比俊美的青年，青年看起来二十多岁的年纪。他双眼如星辰一般闪亮，一头乌黑的长头发搭在了肩膀上，长发随风飘舞，他的衣衫也随着风猎猎作响。
老者不是别人，乃是修仙界的北玄仙尊，一个渡劫大能。
青年则是他在地球上十年前收的徒弟陈锋。
在十年前北玄仙尊在地球游玩的时候发现了年仅15岁遭遇了雷击的陈锋，看到陈锋被雷电轰的奄奄一息，而仙尊在发现陈锋天生灵体后就治愈好了他将他带到了昆仑山修仙，这一待就是十年。
另外陈锋也是天赋异禀，他不光是天生灵体，而且聪慧绝顶，不过短短十年的功夫就进入到了筑基后期了，这修炼的速度比北玄仙尊自己当年都快，当真是万年难遇的奇才，或者是或是妖孽也行。
不过就在今天，北玄仙尊听到了师门传音，他要回修仙灵界去了。
这意味着他要和徒弟陈锋分别，因为陈锋毕竟是地球人，这里是他的故乡，陈锋是不可能和他去灵界的。
“徒弟，为师走之后你就可以下山了，以你如今的修为基本上可以横扫地球了，普天之下没有人是你的对手，到时候你想杀谁就杀谁。”
北玄仙尊看了徒弟一眼，用手捋须微笑道。
“师傅，不知道您老在离开前有什么礼物送给我？”
陈锋也微笑起来，他目光炯炯的看着师傅，他知道师傅有很多宝物，都是一些价值连城的宝物。以前陈锋想要师傅都不给，但是今天他都要和师傅分别了，怎么也得从师傅身上捞点油水。
“呵呵真有你的，天天打师傅的主意，算了这个给你。”
北玄仙尊哈哈大笑起来，声如雷震，震的山峰上的积雪噗噗而落。他将一个碧绿色的空间戒指丢给了徒弟，而空间戒指里面装满了大量的宝物，有神器，丹药等等。
“多谢师傅，对了师傅既然要走了不妨赐予锋儿一个封号吧，这个封号一定要霸气和师傅一样有逼格才行，不然我不要。”
陈锋拿到了戒指将戒指戴在了手指上，他知道师傅绰号北玄仙尊，这个绰号牛逼爆了，他也想要一个。
“呵呵，师傅都要走了干脆师傅的绰号给你用吧，在地球上你以后就是北玄仙尊，或者叫陈北玄也行。”
北玄仙尊似笑非笑的看着陈锋，他在留下这句话后手一挥舞，身子赫然化为了一道流光飞走了。

“徒弟你记住了，仙尊之下皆为蝼蚁，你既然代表为师为仙尊，那么你行走江湖的时候一定要杀伐果断，谁惹了你一掌拍他娘的，或者杀他满门。千万不要辱没了师傅的名头。又或者谁动了你家人，你就要将他抽筋剥皮挫骨扬灰，将他神魂都要湮灭才行，你要记住仙尊不可辱。”
不过在临走之前他还是留了一句传音给徒弟，声音娓娓传来，传到了陈锋的识海里。
“知道了师傅，仙尊不可辱，绝不可辱。”
陈锋对着师傅消失的天空大喊起来，直到师傅彻底消失。
“北玄仙尊，陈北玄，好名称，以后就用这个了。”
师傅走后陈锋嘴里念叨了两句，然后他手一动瞬间召唤出来了一把闪烁着金光的飞行巨剑，他双脚踩在了巨剑上飞走了，他要回自己的所在地，江北楚州区了。
毕竟那是他的老家，他已经有十年没回去了，他好想家里人啊。
……
两个时辰后，江北楚州的某处住宅里，一个老者正在不停的咳嗽，而一个少女正在为他拍打着背部。
少女长得如花似玉，她大概有着20出头的年龄，明眸皓齿，最重要是她的身材无比火爆，那高耸的双峰几乎呼之欲出，她裙子下那双雪白大长腿和牛奶一样细腻。这样的女人无论是什么样男人看她一眼都是无法自拔了吗，都会深深的不可救药爱上她的。
至于老者似乎是少女亲人，因为看到老者咳嗽，少女的脸上充满了焦急。
“爸，你怎么样了啊？还没好吗？”
看到老头咳嗽的厉害，少女几乎哭泣了起来，原来老者是少女的父亲。
“泠汐，爸的肺癌似乎治不好了，可惜爸没看到小锋，爸爸死不瞑目啊。”
老者抽泣了起来，原来老者名叫陈沧海，他的大儿子和儿媳妇和老伴在以前去世了，而如今的他面前的少女则是他的今年刚满20岁的小女儿，陈泠汐。
另外陈沧海还有一个孙子陈锋，孙子是大儿子留下来的遗腹子，可惜陈锋在十年前离奇失踪了。
虽然陈沧海派人寻找了多年一直都没结果，他自然是难受的不行，他太想自己的孙子了。
“小峰他去了哪里了？为什么这十年了他都没回来，他还在吗？“
听到父亲的话，陈泠汐也很是开心，她也非常想小侄子了，虽然这个小侄子比她还大五岁，但是两人终究小时候经常一起玩的，小时候两人一起捉迷藏可开心了。
砰！

不过就在此刻，忽然门被推开了，然后一个人出现在了眼前。
陈泠汐和陈沧海都惊呆了，他们看向了门口这个不速之客。
这是一个头上戴着斗笠，身穿衰衣的青年，青年玉树凌风，英俊挺拔，剑眉星目，长发披肩。而虽然这么多年没见面了，陈沧海和小女儿还是认出来对方竟然是失踪了十年的陈锋。
“爷爷，小姑妈，我回来了。”
content_en:
Kunlun Mountain is covered with white snow, and tall cedars can be seen everywhere, as well as wild animals with white fur emerging from the grass on one side from time to time, or wild cranes passing by the clouds above.
On this day, there were two people standing on the highest and most towering peak in Kunlun Mountain.
One person is an old man with gray hair and a whisk in his hand. The old man's fairy wind and crane bones look like an old god in the sky, or maybe he is a god himself.
The other one is a young man dressed in white with extremely handsome appearance. The young man looks to be in his twenties. His eyes shone like stars, and his long black hair hung on his shoulders. His long hair fluttered in the wind, and his clothes also rustled with the wind.
The old man is none other than Beixuan Immortal Lord in the world of immortality, a great master in overcoming tribulations.
The young man is Chen Feng, the disciple he took on ten years ago on earth.
Ten years ago, when the Beixuan Immortal Master was playing on the earth, he discovered Chen Feng, who was struck by lightning at the age of 15. He saw Chen Feng dying from the lightning strike. The Immortal Master healed him after discovering Chen Feng's natural spiritual body. He took him to Kunlun Mountain to cultivate immortality, and stayed there for ten years.
In addition, Chen Feng is also gifted. Not only is he a natural spirit, but he is also extremely intelligent. However, he has reached the late stage of foundation building in just ten years. His cultivation speed is faster than that of Beixuan Immortal himself. He is really a rare genius who is rarely seen in thousands of years, or he may be a monster.
But just today, Beixuan Immortal Master heard the message from his master that he was going back to the spiritual world of cultivating immortals.
This means that he has to separate from his apprentice Chen Feng, because after all, Chen Feng is from Earth and this is his hometown. It is impossible for Chen Feng to go to the spirit world with him.
"Apprentice, you can go down the mountain after your master leaves. With your current cultivation level, you can basically sweep across the earth. No one in the world is your opponent. You can kill whoever you want."
Beixuan Immortal Lord glanced at his apprentice, smoothed his beard with his hand and smiled.
"Master, I wonder if you have any gifts for me before you leave?"
Chen Feng also smiled. He looked at the master with bright eyes. He knew that the master had many treasures, all of which were priceless. In the past, Chen Feng wouldn't give anything to his master if he wanted it, but today he had to part with his master, and he had to get some money from his master no matter what.
"Haha, it's really yours. I play the master's mind every day, so I'll give this to you."
Beixuan Immortal Lord laughed loudly, the sound was like thunder, and the snow on the mountain peaks fell with a puff. He threw a green space ring to his apprentice, and the space ring was filled with a large number of treasures, including artifacts, elixirs, etc.
"Thank you, master. By the way, since master is leaving, you might as well give Feng'er a title. This title must be as domineering and powerful as the master, otherwise I won't want it."
Chen Feng got the ring and put it on his finger. He knew that his master's nickname was Beixuan Xianzun. This nickname was awesome and he wanted one too.
"Haha, the master is leaving, so I'll give you my master's nickname. From now on on earth, you will be Beixuan Immortal Lord, or you can be called Chen Beixuan."
Beixuan Immortal Lord looked at Chen Feng with a faint smile. After leaving these words, he waved his hand and his body turned into a stream of light and flew away.
"Apprentice, remember, all the Immortal Lords are ants. Since you represent the Master and the Immortal Lord, you must be decisive when walking around the world. Anyone who offends you will slap his mother in the face, or kill him in the whole family. Don't insult the master's name. Or if someone touches your family, you have to cramp his muscles, peel off his skin, crush his bones and spread his ashes, and annihilate his soul. You must remember that the Immortal Lord cannot be insulted."
However, before leaving, he still left a message for his apprentice. The voice came softly and reached Chen Feng's sea of consciousness.
"I understand, Master, the Immortal Lord cannot be humiliated, and must never be humiliated."
Chen Feng shouted at the sky where the master disappeared, until the master knewThe bottom disappears.
"Beixuan Immortal Lord, Chen Beixuan, a good name, I will use this from now on."
After the master left, Chen Feng muttered a few words, and then he moved his hand and instantly summoned a flying giant sword that shone with golden light. He stepped on the giant sword with both feet and flew away. He was going back to his place, Chuzhou District, Jiangbei.
After all, that was his hometown and he hadn't been back for ten years. He missed his family so much.
…
Two hours later, in a residence in Chuzhou, Jiangbei, an old man was coughing non-stop, and a girl was patting his back.
The girl looks like a flower. She is probably in her early 20s, with bright eyes and white teeth. The most important thing is that her figure is extremely hot. Her towering breasts are almost ready to be seen. The long snow-white legs under her skirt are as delicate as milk. Such a woman, no matter what kind of man he is, can't help but fall in love with her deeply and hopelessly when he looks at her.
As for the old man, it seemed that he was a relative of the girl, because when she saw the old man coughing, the girl's face was full of anxiety.
"Dad, how are you? Are you still okay?"
Seeing the old man coughing so hard, the girl almost cried. It turned out that the old man was the girl's father.
"Lingxi, it seems that Dad's lung cancer cannot be cured. It's a pity that Dad didn't see Xiao Feng. Dad won't die in peace."
The old man started sobbing. It turned out that the old man's name was Chen Canghai. His eldest son, daughter-in-law and wife had passed away before, and the girl in front of him now was his youngest daughter, Chen Lingxi, who had just turned 20 this year.
In addition, Chen Canghai also has a grandson, Chen Feng, who is the posthumous son of his eldest son. Unfortunately, Chen Feng disappeared mysteriously ten years ago.
Although Chen Canghai sent people to search for him for many years with no results, he was naturally very uncomfortable. He missed his grandson too much.
"Where did Xiaofeng go? Why hasn't he come back in the past ten years? Is he still there?"
Chen Lingxi was also very happy when she heard her father's words. She also missed her nephew very much. Although this nephew was five years older than her, they had often played together when they were children. They had fun playing hide and seek together when they were children.
Bang!
But at this moment, the door was suddenly pushed open, and a person appeared in front of him.
Chen Lingxi and Chen Canghai were both stunned. They looked at the uninvited guest at the door.
This is a young man with a bamboo hat on his head and poor clothes. The young man is tall and handsome, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and long hair shawl. Even though they hadn't seen each other for so many years, Chen Canghai and his youngest daughter still recognized each other as Chen Feng, who had been missing for ten years.
"Grandpa, little aunt, I'm back."
